description: Spanish and English searches included weekly date windows, national/local reporting, regional department terms and women/education/labor/transport/religion dimensions. Local event leads found were an officialist commemorative walk and a Costa Rica diaspora march; outside Managua local coverage is thin, and search results frequently surfaced 2018–2019 protest histories or later retrospectives. Open-web methods do not establish zero protests.
required_followup: If reviewer identifies a region/sector gap, search fresh Spanish local sources in León, Matagalpa, Chinandega, Caribe/Bluefields and verify any proposed gathering’s own-state target; do not reuse the existing queries as new searches.
